scripts.lint:clang-format: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; mapfile -t files < <(find ./src \( -name "*.cpp" -o -name "*.hpp" \) | sort); clang-format --dry-run --Werror "${files[@]}" ./config.h.in'
scripts.lint:cmake: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; shopt -s nullglob; mapfile -t files < <(find . -iname CMakeLists.txt -not -path "./node_modules/*" -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./deps/*" -not -path "./build/*" -not -path "./releases/*" | sort); cmake-lint --suppress-decorations "${files[@]}" ./cmake/*.cmake ./cmake_uninstall.cmake.in'
scripts.lint:shellcheck: bash -c 'shopt -s nullglob; set -- bin/*.sh test/*.sh; (($#)) || exit 0; exec shellcheck $@'
